implementation_scope: Complete source feature/route/model/event/file/integration ledger, not a CRUD subset
closure_rules: Every source ledger row has explicit cases; counts and row IDs reconcile across frontend, backend and runtime ledgers without omission.
PASS requires actual captured evidence and independent operator; code presence, syntax check, HTTP 200, screenshot alone, mocks and PHP proxies do not qualify.
BLOCKED, NOT_RUN and missing evidence prevent full migration acceptance; no implicit N/A or scope deletion.
Documented security defects in legacy behavior are not blindly reproduced; deliberate security changes require explicit contract and regression evidence.
No production data/credentials; isolated synthetic accounts, database and upload store with rollback and cleanup ownership.

cases.steps: Open every ledger frontend route in real Chromium, including deep-link direct load, refresh, dialogs, responsive states, locale/theme and browser navigation; capture source and migrated screenshots under matching viewport and account state.
cases.oracle: Preserved frontend source/assets except explicitly authorized deployment adaptation; functional parity per route; no unexpected console exceptions or failed required resources; screenshots plus interaction/network evidence.

cases.steps: Exercise real login, incorrect credentials, expiry, logout, session invalidation, password changes and every discovered authentication method against FastAPI.
cases.oracle: Exact documented token/cookie/header/ret-msg-data contract; revoked or expired credentials cannot read/write or subscribe; no credentials in committed traces.

cases.steps: For every protected API, WS channel, file and UI operation run anonymous, allowed owner/member/admin and denied unrelated-user cases, including guessed identifiers and cross-organization access.
cases.oracle: Positive action succeeds; denied action returns contract error without leaking fields, side effects, uploaded bytes or events; UI visibility is not authorization.

cases.steps: Create/update/delete each persistent entity through real UI/API; record canonical IDs and SQL state; stop and restart owned FastAPI workers and storage services using the same isolated persistent volumes; repeat reads in a fresh browser session and separate process.
cases.oracle: Committed records/relationships/attachments survive restart; deletion semantics and transactions match contract; rejected requests leave no partial writes; process-memory mock cannot pass.

cases.steps: Exercise every effective source route and public dynamic dispatch candidate with actual allowed methods, query/form/JSON inputs, pagination, sort/filter, Unicode, dates, error branches and response shapes; compare normalized golden source captures to migrated captures.
cases.oracle: HTTP status, envelope, business error, null/empty/number encoding, ordering, mutation and side effects match approved contract; docs alone do not define reachability.

cases.steps: Use two real clients with independent accounts to exercise every event, authentication, subscription, heartbeat, disconnect/reconnect, ordering and offline/unread behavior; attempt unauthorized subscription and revoked-token connection.
cases.oracle: Recorded WS frames and corresponding durable state prove intended recipients and event shape; no cross-user broadcast leak; timing tolerances declared before running, not retrofitted.

cases.steps: Upload real non-empty files through UI and every file API, including multipart/chunk paths, Unicode names, configured limits, cancellation, duplicate handling, previews, download/range/WebDAV/shares when in ledger, deletion and restart; attempt traversal and unauthorized direct access.
cases.oracle: Downloaded bytes hash equals uploaded bytes, metadata and access control survive restart, unsafe paths are rejected and denied actions leave no orphan/public object; external conversion failures are explicit.

cases.steps: Exercise all discovered scheduled/background work, notices, retries defined by existing contract, cache invalidation and multi-worker interactions using controlled time and real persistence.
cases.oracle: Contract side effects occur exactly as specified; no lost/duplicate effects beyond explicit contract, no request state leakage; capture jobs plus DB/events.

cases.steps: Exercise each discovered external integration and subapplication with authorized test credentials/services, including app-store, editor/office, LDAP/mail/push/meeting/AI only where source ledger requires them; verify denial and unavailable-service behavior.
cases.oracle: Real service proof required; absence of credentials/services remains BLOCKED, not mock PASS; licensing and embedded frontend ownership remain preserved.

cases.steps: After implementation freeze, independent owner runs approved build/lint/test commands once, then records process command lines, listeners and network/service dependencies during the complete UI/API/WS/file run.
cases.oracle: Backend business behavior is executed by FastAPI, not PHP forwarding; intentional licensed external integrations distinguished from legacy backend delegation; complete report links process, artifact, source and runtime evidence.

cases.steps: Obtain authorized original doo.so artifact with immutable image digest, file SHA-256, platform ABI and explicit usage/distribution rights; establish golden behavior for existing passwords, registration, tokens, PGP and license boundaries using isolated authorized data.
cases.oracle: Source FFI declarations alone do not prove ABI semantics or binary rights; arbitrary JWT/bcrypt substitution and license bypass cannot pass. Missing native artifact, lawful rights or old-data compatibility evidence blocks acceptance.

cases.steps: Cross-check final copied source and delivered artifacts against protocol/license report and pinned dependency/submodule versions; inspect notices, modification dates and corresponding-source access.
cases.oracle: No removed LICENSE/copyright, false MIT relabel, brand/online-license bypass or unproven redistribution rights; same-version provenance recorded.

evidence_requirements: one result row per source obligation
current_gate: G1 evidence only; zero application/build/lint/test executions in this assignment
